sources.title: akai_haato_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive]]'s [[Akai Haato]].

It consists of a [[white shirt|white]], [[short sleeves|short-sleeved]] [[collared shirt]] with a [[red ribbon|red]] [[neck ribbon]], a [[blue skirt|blue]] [[high-waist skirt|high-waist]] [[miniskirt]] with a [[red belt|red]] [[underbust]] belt, a red [[thigh belt]], [[black thighhighs]] and [[brown shoes|brown]] [[loafers]].

h4. Appearance
